mapper.select: /* selectSetMenu */ WITH TBM AS ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'MENUSEQ_'||MENU_SEQ AS MENU_SEQ ,MENU_ID ,MENU_NM ,MENU_NM_ENG ,MENU_DESC ,MENU_ICON ,ACCESS_RIGHT ,(CASE WHEN PARENT_ID IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'MENUSEQ_'||PARENT_ID END) AS PARENT_ID ,SORT_ORDER ,POPUP_FLAG FROM TB_M_MENUCFG WHERE 1=1 AND MENU_SEQ IN (SELECT MENU_SEQ FROM TB_M_MENU_SUBSCRIBE WHERE USER_ID = #{in_userId}) AND USE_FLAG IN ('Y') ) WHERE 1 = 1 ORDER BY MENU_SEQ ) SELECT a.* ,(SELECT COUNT(A.MENU_SEQ) FROM TBM WHERE A.MENU_SEQ = PARENT_ID) PARENT_CNT FROM TBM A ORDER BY PARENT_ID DESC, TO_NUMBER(SORT_ORDER) ASC

SELECT MENU_SEQ ,MENU_ID ,MENU_NM ,MENU_NM_ENG ,MENU_DESC ,MENU_ICON ,ACCESS_RIGHT ,USE_FLAG ,POPUP_FLAG ,URL ,PARENT_ID ,SORT_ORDER FROM TB_M_MENUCFG WHERE MENU_ID = #{in_menuId} AND MENU_SEQ IN (SELECT MENU_SEQ FROM TB_M_MENU_SUBSCRIBE WHERE USER_ID = #{in_userId}) AND USE_FLAG ='Y'
